Full Stack Architecture Overview

Detailed breakdown of the hardware, software, security, and network layers powering our infrastructure.

Compute & Virtualization

AMD EPYC™ & Intel® Xeon® Scalable CPUs

Latest-generation high-core density processors delivering maximum single-thread and multi-thread performance.

100% KVM Hypervisor Isolation

Dedicated CPU cycles and isolated memory space for VPS instances with zero noisy-neighbor performance degradation.

Bare-Metal Single-Tenant Access

Direct physical hardware control with zero hypervisor overhead for mission-critical enterprise workloads.

Storage Architecture

100% NVMe SSD RAID 10 Storage

Enterprise PCIe Gen4 NVMe arrays delivering up to 7,000 MB/s read/write speeds and 850,000 IOPS.

Automated JetBackup Snapshots

Daily incremental off-site backups with 30-day retention and 1-click file/database restoration.

Self-Healing Ceph Storage Clusters

Distributed storage replication ensuring zero data loss even in the event of double physical disk failure.

Security & DDoS Defense

2Tbps+ Volumetric DDoS Shield

Automated L3/L4/L7 attack scrubbing at the edge. Mitigates SYN floods, UDP amplification, and HTTP floods in <1s.

Imunify360 Proactive Security

Real-time AI malware scanning, Web Application Firewall (WAF), automated patch management, and brute-force protection.

Free Automated SSL Certificates

Instant Let's Encrypt SSL provisioning for all primary domains, subdomains, and addon domains with auto-renewal.

Web Server & Caching

LiteSpeed Enterprise Web Server

Drop-in Apache replacement handling up to 10x more concurrent web connections with minimal CPU overhead.

LSCache & Redis Acceleration

Server-level object and page caching built natively for WordPress, WooCommerce, Magento, and Node.js.

HTTP/3 & QUIC Protocol

Next-gen multiplexed transport protocol reducing mobile connection handshake latency by up to 50%.

Global Network & Anycast

10Gbps Unmetered Network Uplinks

High-throughput redundant uplinks connected directly to Tier-1 transit providers (Lumen, Telia, Cogent, NTT).

Global Anycast DNS Network

Sub-10ms DNS lookup latency served from 25+ global edge locations with 100% SLA uptime.

BGP / BYOIP Routing Support

Announce your own IPv4 subnets (/24 or larger) and custom BGP sessions for enterprise hybrid clouds.

Developer Tools & AI

HostingSpell AI Co-Pilot Builder

Generate complete responsive websites from a single prompt and refine layout tokens live via natural language chat.

Multi-Runtime Support (Node, Python, Go)

1-Click application selector for Node.js 20+, Python 3.12 (WSGI/ASGI), Ruby, Go, and PHP 8.3.

Git Integration & CI/CD Webhooks

Automatic deployment pipelines from GitHub and GitLab repositories upon code commit.
